steps.content:
Chief's Office
10:00 a.m., February 23, N.F. 113
You hear a commotion. A gaggle of Sinners addicted to board games has gathered outside your office, clamoring to play with you. Nightingale spreads her arms to keep them from bursting in.

You take out a thick envelope of documents with your left hand and place it on the desk, then a second one, and a third one. At last, you pull out a huge cardboard box from under the chair with one hand.
These are the files you will be dealing with today.
Two hours later, your work in the morning is finally done. You flip open a routine report of the Supervision Terminal and read it leisurely.
A tiny brown card drops out of the report. Then another, and another. A few dozen cards shower down on the desk.
What could they be? You wonder.
"Chief, come and play the new modle of Dragon & Isle of Sky with us!" Hella

"Chief, we're one player short. We've decided on our characters, and we're waiting for you to lead us in our adventure." 
EMP

"Dear Chief, may I... May I invite you to join us...?" 
Victoria

"I have a game recommendation for you." 
Mess
Each card carries a message written by a Sinner. Hella's spelling is off again. You're sure she's been skipping her classes because she's all hooked on board games.
You shake your head and gather up the cards. They make for good keepsakes, even if you have no time to play the game with them.
How they've managed to sneak the cards in under Nightingale's watchful eyes is beyond you. You'd very much like to learn the trick from them, frankly.
You stack the cards together and set them aside. A floral scent suddenly spreads in the office, and the message cards gather to form an old-fashioned invitation in the air.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Girl
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>At long last, I've been waiting for you! You're the number one player on our friends invite list and the most popular <color=#fb9259>new player</color> we've had!</color>
What's the meaning of this?!

steps.speaker: Mysterious Girl
steps.content: Hehe! Invitation accepted. Contract established. The game is to begin now. Welcome to the grand adventure of Dragon & Isle of Sky!
Before you can say anything, the floral scent thickens and that voice seems to draw your consciousness out of your body, throwing it into an unknown void.
The scene as huge as a movie screen fades out right before your eyes. You find yourself fallen on a white ice field.
The wind screeches and icy snowflakes fall on you, melting instantly. The snow under your feet is slightly dented, squeaking with each step you take.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Girl
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>How's that? That's a dope opening scene, isn't it?</color>
Pink petals drop onto your shoulders with the snow. The Game Master's voice rings in your heart.
Telepathy? She can hear your thoughts? ...Is this <color=#fb9259>Sinner</color> power?
The shackles don't respond to that voice or anything in the surroundings. You can't detect the source of the voice, and your power is even being restrained.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Girl
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>No cheating in my <color=#fb9259>game</color>! You must follow the rules. Play your role, find your friends, and complete the adventure!</color>
You quickly fumble for your communication device only to realize you've already changed into an entirely different outfit. You pat yourself down and find nothing...
Clank.
A white <color=#fb9259>six-sided dice</color> falls on the snow.
The pattern on the dice is clearly visible. Apparently, you haven't been teleported to some forgotten corner of the real world, but into a highly realistic <color=#fb9259>fantasy world</color>.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Girl
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>Don't lose that, it's important. It's proof that you're </color><color=#fb9259>the Chosen One</color>.
What on earth is this place? What does she mean by the Chosen One? As you process all this, the dice on the ground suddenly appears in your palm. When it stops rolling, the four is on top.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Girl
steps.content: <color=#7683a2><size=44>Ta ta ta tum! Let's pass a trial first.</color></size>

steps.speaker: Mysterious Girl
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>To your northwest is the High Watch that blocks the chilly winds. To your southwest is Sky Land where the ancestors first landed. Judging from that, you're now around the Celestial Well!</color>

steps.speaker: Mysterious Girl
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>As for your goal... Well, of course, it's no other than <color=#fb9259>saving the world</color>! Didn't you pay attention to the opening scene? The world is in peril, and only you, <color=#fb9259>the Chosen One</color>, can salvage it!</color>
